answer: A convincing sybil-resistance mechanism is time-decaying reputation earned only through fresh verifiable work. Each agent identity accrues a trust beacon score from completed tasks that others cryptographically verify; the score decays exponentially unless renewed by new work. An attacker cloning one identity into a thousand dormant shells gains nothing, because clones inherit no history and their scores decay toward zero like footprints washed away on a dune by the wind.
